verdict.rationale: ClickUp's own site markets a built-in "Super Agent" that can "delegate any task" and "works 24/7". It also offers specialized in-product agents (Codegen Agent, Triage Agent), the ability to build your own agent, and Brain², which sees tasks, docs and conversations in real time. Missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation of how delegation works (assignment flow, scope, limits, approvals), and independent or hands-on corroboration that delegated tasks are actually completed; the evidence is only marketing taglines.
